description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the WorkScheduleService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing its behavior in various scenarios such as missing or invalid work schedule implementations. It includes mock setups and test cases for constructor exceptions and type validations.

classes.name: WorkScheduleServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the WorkScheduleService, testing various scenarios of retrieving work schedule implementation and validating type compliance.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClass
classes.description: A stub class intentionally not implementing the required interface for testing class validation.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleInvalidClassExceptionInConstructor
classes.description: A class designed to throw an exception during instantiation for testing constructor error handling.

classes.name: TestWorkScheduleValidClass
classes.description: A mock implementation of WorkScheduleInterface used to simulate a valid work schedule class in tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by instantiating the WorkScheduleService before each test.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleNotDefined
methods.description: Tests behavior when the work schedule implementation is not provided (null).

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassNotFound
methods.description: Tests behavior when the specified class name for the work schedule implementation does not exist.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests behavior when the class does not implement the required interface.

methods.name: testGetWorkScheduleClassExceptionInConstructor
methods.description: Tests behavior when an exception is thrown during the instantiation of the work schedule class.

methods.name: testGetWorkSchedule
methods.description: Validates that the service correctly retrieves and instantiates a valid work schedule class.
